title: Privacy Policy
intro: Ponderam is a multiplayer word and category game. This policy explains what information we use, why we use it, and how you can contact us about your privacy.

sections.heading: 1. Information we use
paragraphs: When you create an account or use Ponderam, we may process your email address through our authentication provider, Supabase, to manage sign-in and your account.
Your Ponderam profile may contain your username, avatar, total score, coins, streak, reliability information, and game history or identifiers associated with your games.
We also process information needed to operate multiplayer games, such as room details, answers, submissions, and marking results.

sections.heading: 2. Public profiles and leaderboard
paragraphs: Ponderam's public leaderboard displays player usernames, avatars, and total scores. This information may be visible to visitors who are not signed in.
Do not choose a username or avatar that contains personal information you do not want to make public.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use information to operate accounts, run games, calculate and display scores, maintain the leaderboard, support multiplayer features, and protect the reliability of gameplay.
We do not intentionally display account email addresses on the public leaderboard.

sections.heading: 4. Service providers and storage
paragraphs: Ponderam uses Supabase for database and authentication services. Information needed to provide these features is processed through that service.
Information may be stored and processed by our service providers in accordance with their terms and privacy practices. We will update this policy if our data practices materially change.

sections.heading: 5. Retention and security
paragraphs: We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service, maintain game records, meet applicable legal obligations, and address disputes or abuse.
We use appropriate measures to protect information, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 6. Your choices and rights
paragraphs: You can contact us to ask about your personal information, request access or correction, or ask for deletion where applicable law provides that right.
Some information may need to be retained for legitimate operational or legal reasons. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

sections.heading: 7. Children's privacy
paragraphs: Ponderam is not intended for children who are not permitted to use the service under applicable law. If you believe a child has provided personal information inappropriately, please contact us.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as Ponderam develops. The latest version and its update date will be published on this page.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions or requests, email hello@ponderam.com.
